nodes.name: adapt.md
nodes.summary: Reference for the /impeccable adapt command: rethinking a design for a new screen size, device, or platform instead of merely scaling it.

nodes.name: animate.md
nodes.summary: Reference for the /impeccable animate command: adding motion that conveys state and feedback while cutting decorative animation and respecting performance and reduced-motion.

nodes.name: audit.md
nodes.summary: Reference for the /impeccable audit command: a code-level technical quality scan producing a report of measurable issues without fixing them.

nodes.name: bolder.md
nodes.summary: Reference for the /impeccable bolder command: increasing visual impact via hierarchy, scale, and decisive type while rejecting cliche gradient/glassmorphism tricks.

nodes.name: brand.md
nodes.summary: Defines the brand register, where design is the product (landing, marketing, portfolio pages), with genre-spanning guidance and slop tests.

nodes.name: clarify.md
nodes.summary: Reference for the /impeccable clarify command: finding and rewriting vague or confusing interface copy into specific, task-completing text.

nodes.name: codex.md
nodes.summary: Codex-only companion for the craft flow covering visual direction and raster asset production via native image generation.

nodes.name: colorize.md
nodes.summary: Reference for the /impeccable colorize command: choosing a color strategy and hue family and applying a palette with intent rather than adding more color.

nodes.name: craft.md
nodes.summary: Describes the craft flow: shape the design, land visual direction, build production code, and iterate in-browser to a studio-quality bar.

nodes.name: critique.md
nodes.summary: Detailed critique workflow: resolve a stable target, run two independent assessments, synthesize a design critique, persist a snapshot, and prompt for next improvements.

nodes.name: delight.md
nodes.summary: Reference for the /impeccable delight command: finding the moments where personality and unexpected polish are earned, without turning delight into noise.

nodes.name: distill.md
nodes.summary: Reference for the /impeccable distill command: stripping a design to its essence by removing redundant, decorative, or cosmetically complex elements.

nodes.name: document.md
nodes.summary: Reference for the /impeccable document command: generating a DESIGN.md in the Google Stitch format with YAML token frontmatter and six fixed sections.

nodes.name: extract.md
nodes.summary: Describes the extract flow: discovering the design system and consolidating reusable patterns, components, and tokens into it.

nodes.name: harden.md
nodes.summary: Reference for the /impeccable harden command: making interfaces robust against real-world data, errors, languages, and network conditions.

nodes.name: hooks.md
nodes.summary: Documents the /impeccable hooks command that manages the design-detector PostToolUse hook on design-relevant file edits.

nodes.name: init.md
nodes.summary: Describes the init flow: a single codebase crawl that writes PRODUCT.md (strategic) and DESIGN.md (visual) for a project.

nodes.name: interaction-design.md
nodes.summary: Interaction design reference covering the eight interactive states, feedback timing, and affordance rules every element must satisfy.

nodes.name: layout.md
nodes.summary: Reference for the /impeccable layout command: diagnosing structural spacing and hierarchy problems and fixing structure rather than surface.

nodes.name: live.md
nodes.summary: Describes live variant mode: selecting browser elements, picking a design action, and hot-swapping AI-generated HTML+CSS variants through dev-server HMR.
